fact: Nigeria's National AI Innovation Challenge, open from 22 September 2026, asks builders to develop tools and sector fine-tunes on N-ATLAS, the open-source multilingual LLM fine-tuned from Llama-3 8B for Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo and Nigerian-accented English, with N-ATLAS API credentials and compute credits offered to teams.
title: National AI Innovation Challenge 2026: Build with N-ATLAS
publisher: NCAIR / Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy
